purpose: CPU engineering canary, not a strength experiment or continuation fix
value: sigmoid of the original linear value output; zero value weights/bias initialize to 0.5
actor: Original M3 hidden layer, logits, exact binary-tree categorical law and word/key addresses; equality is at identical parameters, not after learning
targets: Original same-player GAE; gamma=1, lambda=0.95; terminal win1/loss0; cutoff bootstrap is the bounded head; FP32 return range tolerance 2e-6
loss: Original clipped PPO + 0.5 times half-MSE on bounded predictions - 0.01 entropy; stored targets detached; shared trunk retained
profile: Unchanged gen9-starter-pairs-v1, 12 turns, 14 groups, 32 games per update; cutoff games reset
replay_audits: Initial and final saved state per seed each checked against its original next update; audit outputs discarded, never counted as training progression
reference_domain: Independent NumPy network and analytic PPO gradients only where every legal binary conditional is away from the rare-mass floor; actor-law floor/extreme behavior checked by exact inheritance and sampling parity

acceptance.actor_input: Only original ActorInput/player view, no privileged state

limitations: Sigmoid can saturate; a bounded constant prediction can still be unanchored. No supervised turn-13 continuation, strength, calibration, two-hour qualification, full G2/G3/G4, public server or final reserved data use.
